what: Serverless cold start of Qwen3.5-9B FP8 on vLLM 0.32.0 (runpod/worker-v1-vllm:v2.30.0), L40S, EU-NL-1, max 1 worker. Times from the worker's own logs (container start to 'Starting Serverless Worker') plus the endpoint health states (GPU assigned to first answer).

A_empty_volume.note: approx: worker got a GPU ~17:59:45 local, served 18:07:02; its logs were gone once it scaled down

B_filled_volume_default_env.note: HF_HOME + VLLM_CACHE_ROOT on the volume: compile graph reused, but Triton kernels were cached in /tmp ('Cubin file ... not found') and recompiled during warmup

C_populate_kernel_caches.note: first run with TORCHINDUCTOR_CACHE_DIR and TRITON_CACHE_DIR on the volume: fills them

gpu_queue_waits_s.note: EU-NL-1 is the only data centre with L40S that takes network volumes; the volume pins the endpoint there
